phases.label: Phase 1
phases.name: Dashboard Shell
phases.description: The live discovery shell at app.minepanel.xyz: a static, installable React PWA that connects the browser directly to operator-selected self-hosted backends.

items.text: Deploy to app.minepanel.xyz via Cloudflare Pages
Multi-backend instance registry (IndexedDB, local metadata only)
Strict origin validation (public HTTPS DNS only; rejects IPs, localhost, .local)
Backend probe via public GET /api/info (name & version)
Installable PWA with same-origin app-shell caching
Security headers, strict CSP and SPA fallback on Cloudflare Pages
Unit tests for origin validation, instance registry and backend client

phases.label: Phase 1.5
phases.name: Hosted Authentication
phases.description: Login, sessions and 2FA for the hosted dashboard. Blocked on owner decision D-1 (hosted-frontend cross-origin auth: CHIPS partitioned cookies as primary, PKCE authorization-code fallback) and backend capability discovery (B-P2-11).

items.text: Resolve D-1: cross-origin HttpOnly cookie design (CHIPS / PKCE fallback)
Capability discovery from /api/info (never infer from version strings)
Login, refresh single-flight and logout flows
2FA (TOTP) challenge flow
OAuth (Google / GitHub) per backend Phase 1.5

phases.label: Phase 2
phases.name: Dashboard Management
phases.description: Authenticated server management surface: lifecycle controls, host metrics and role-aware UI against the backend's REST + WebSocket API.

items.text: Server list and lifecycle controls (create, start, stop, restart, delete)
Host metrics (CPU, RAM, disk) via WebSocket
Role-aware interface (ADMIN / MOD / USER, per-server permissions)
Admin user management and approval flows

phases.label: Phase 3
phases.name: Operations
phases.description: Real-time console, backups, scheduled tasks, notifications, file manager and plugin management as the backend Phase 3 API lands.

items.text: Real-time console and server event stream
Backups and scheduled tasks
Notifications
File manager
Plugin management (Modrinth / Hangar)
